definition_en: To leave something or someone permanently.
example_en: The village was abandoned after the drought.

definition_en: To take in liquid heat or information.
example_en: Plants absorb water through their roots.

definition_en: To make something happen faster.
example_en: Warm weather accelerated the melting of ice.

definition_en: Easy to reach use or understand.
example_en: The museum is accessible to wheelchair users.

definition_en: To provide space or adapt to needs.
example_en: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.

definition_en: To go somewhere with someone.
example_en: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
example_uz: Bolalarga katta yoshli hamrohlik qilishi shart.

definition_en: Very serious or severe.
example_en: There is an acute shortage of water.

definition_en: To stick to a rule or surface.
example_en: Drivers must adhere to the rules.

definition_en: Next to something.
example_en: The school is adjacent to the park.

definition_en: A young person developing into an adult.
example_en: Adolescents need more sleep than adults.
example_uz: O'smirlarga kattalardan ko'ra ko'proq uyqu kerak.

definition_en: Relating to beauty.
example_en: The bridge has aesthetic as well as practical value.
example_uz: Ko'prik amaliy qiymatdan tashqari estetik qiymatga ham ega.

definition_en: Having a lot of money.
example_en: They live in an affluent neighbourhood.

definition_en: Farming and growing crops.
example_en: Agriculture employs half the region's workers.
example_uz: Qishloq xo'jaligi mintaqa ishchilarining yarmini band qiladi.

definition_en: To arrange in a line; to bring into agreement.
example_en: The curriculum is aligned with exam requirements.

definition_en: To claim something without proof.
example_en: The report alleges serious safety failures.
example_uz: Hisobot jiddiy xavfsizlik kamchiliklarini da'vo qiladi.

definition_en: A country or person that supports another.
example_en: The two nations became close allies.

definition_en: More than enough.
example_en: There is ample parking near the stadium.
example_uz: Stadion yonida yetarlicha to'xtash joyi bor.

definition_en: With the name kept secret.
example_en: The donation came from an anonymous giver.

definition_en: Equipment for a particular purpose.
example_en: The lab bought new breathing apparatus.
example_uz: Laboratoriya yangi nafas olish uskunasini sotib oldi.

definition_en: To attract or interest; to make a serious request.
example_en: The idea appeals to young voters.

definition_en: A machine used in the home.
example_en: Modern appliances save time and energy.
example_uz: Zamonaviy maishiy texnika vaqt va energiyani tejaydi.

definition_en: Relevant to a situation.
example_en: The rule is applicable to all students.

definition_en: To choose someone for a job officially.
example_en: She was appointed head teacher.

definition_en: To begin to exist or happen.
example_en: Problems arise when rules are unclear.
example_uz: Qoidalar noaniq bo'lsa muammolar paydo bo'ladi.

definition_en: Able to express ideas clearly.
example_en: She is an articulate speaker.

definition_en: To want to achieve something great.
example_en: Many students aspire to study abroad.
example_uz: Ko'p talabalar chet elda o'qishga intiladi.

definition_en: To put together; to gather.
example_en: The furniture is easy to assemble.

definition_en: To state firmly.
example_en: He asserted that the data was correct.

definition_en: Something valuable that a person or company owns.
example_en: Fluent English is a real asset.

definition_en: To fully absorb information or fit into a group.
example_en: Children assimilate new languages quickly.

definition_en: The air around the Earth; the mood of a place.
example_en: The cafe has a relaxed atmosphere.

definition_en: An official examination of accounts.
example_en: The company passed its annual audit.

definition_en: Real and genuine.
example_en: The restaurant serves authentic Uzbek plov.
example_uz: Restoran asl o'zbek oshini taklif qiladi.

definition_en: To make a process work by machines.
example_en: The factory automated its packing line.

definition_en: The right to govern or decide for yourself.
example_en: Teachers need autonomy in the classroom.

definition_en: To prevent something bad from happening.
example_en: Quick action averted a disaster.

definition_en: Something that blocks progress or movement.
example_en: Language is the biggest barrier for migrants.
example_uz: Til migrantlar uchun eng katta to'siq.

definition_en: A standard used for comparison.
example_en: The test sets a benchmark for schools.

definition_en: Having a good effect.
example_en: Exercise is beneficial to mental health.

definition_en: The variety of plant and animal life.
example_en: Forests are rich in biodiversity.

definition_en: A close connection between people or things.
example_en: The twins share a strong bond.

definition_en: A line that marks the edge of an area.
example_en: The river forms a natural boundary.

definition_en: An important discovery or development.
example_en: Scientists made a breakthrough in cancer research.
example_uz: Olimlar saraton tadqiqotida katta yutuqqa erishdi.

definition_en: To keep animals to produce young; to reproduce.
example_en: Farmers breed sheep for wool.

definition_en: The main or largest part of something.
example_en: The bulk of the budget goes to salaries.

definition_en: Complicated official rules and processes.
example_en: Bureaucracy slows down small businesses.

definition_en: A chemical element found in all living things.
example_en: Cars produce carbon emissions.

definition_en: Something that causes change or speeds it up.
example_en: The report was a catalyst for reform.

definition_en: To provide what is needed or wanted.
example_en: The school caters for children of all abilities.
example_uz: Maktab barcha qobiliyatdagi bolalarga xizmat ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: An official count of a population.
example_en: The census takes place every ten years.
example_uz: Aholi ro'yxati har o'n yilda o'tkaziladi.

definition_en: Lasting a long time and hard to cure.
example_en: Chronic stress damages health.

definition_en: To move around continuously; to spread.
example_en: Blood circulates through the body.

definition_en: To mention as an example or source.
example_en: Cite at least three sources in your essay.

definition_en: Relating to a city or its citizens.
example_en: Voting is a civic duty.

definition_en: A well-organized and developed society.
example_en: Ancient civilizations arose along rivers.
example_uz: Qadimgi tamaddunlar daryolar bo'yida vujudga kelgan.

definition_en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand.
example_en: The teacher explained the rule with great clarity.

definition_en: Near the sea.
example_en: Coastal cities face rising sea levels.
example_uz: Qirg'oqbo'yi shaharlari dengiz sathi ko'tarilishiga duch kelmoqda.

definition_en: Relating to thinking and understanding.
example_en: Games improve children's cognitive skills.

definition_en: To crash into each other.
example_en: Two trains nearly collided in the fog.

definition_en: The buying and selling of goods.
example_en: Online commerce is growing rapidly.

definition_en: Shared by a group of people.
example_en: The building has a communal garden.

definition_en: To travel regularly between home and work.
example_en: She commutes an hour each way.
example_uz: U har tomonga bir soatdan qatnaydi.

definition_en: Similar enough to be compared.
example_en: The two cities are comparable in size.

definition_en: To collect information into one document.
example_en: She compiled a list of useful phrases.

definition_en: To combine well with something.
example_en: The exercises complement the lectures.

definition_en: The act of obeying rules.
example_en: Factories are checked for safety compliance.

definition_en: To hide something.
example_en: He concealed his disappointment.

definition_en: To admit something unwillingly.
example_en: She conceded that the plan had failed.
example_uz: U reja barbod bo'lganini tan oldi.

definition_en: To criticize strongly.
example_en: World leaders condemned the attack.

definition_en: To make shorter or more compact.
example_en: Condense the report into one page.

definition_en: To discuss with others; to give an honour.
example_en: The judges conferred before deciding.

definition_en: To face a problem or person directly.
example_en: We must confront the water shortage.

definition_en: Overcrowding especially of traffic.
example_en: Road congestion costs the city millions.
example_uz: Yo'l tirbandligi shaharga millionlab zarar keltiradi.

definition_en: To defeat or take control by force.
example_en: She conquered her fear of heights.

definition_en: To make stronger or combine into one.
example_en: Review sessions consolidate learning.

definition_en: To make something impure or dirty.
example_en: Chemicals contaminated the river.

definition_en: To think about something seriously.
example_en: He contemplated changing careers.
example_uz: U kasbini o'zgartirish haqida mulohaza yuritdi.

definition_en: To argue or compete for something.
example_en: Critics contend that the law is unfair.
example_uz: Tanqidchilar qonun adolatsiz deb da'vo qiladi.

definition_en: Opposite in meaning or direction.
example_en: Contrary to expectations sales rose.

definition_en: To come together from different directions.
example_en: Fans converged on the stadium.

definition_en: To deal successfully with something difficult.
example_en: She copes well with exam pressure.
example_uz: U imtihon bosimiga yaxshi bardosh beradi.

definition_en: Relating to large companies.
example_en: Corporate taxes were reduced.

definition_en: A person or thing with the same role elsewhere.
example_en: The minister met his French counterpart.

definition_en: A time of great difficulty or danger.
example_en: The country faced an energy crisis.

definition_en: To grow crops; to develop a skill or attitude.
example_en: Farmers cultivate rice in the valley.

definition_en: To control or limit something.
example_en: New rules aim to curb pollution.

definition_en: The subjects taught at a school.
example_en: Coding was added to the curriculum.

definition_en: To be slowly destroyed naturally.
example_en: Sugar makes teeth decay.

definition_en: Lacking something needed.
example_en: The diet is deficient in iron.

definition_en: The amount by which spending exceeds income.
example_en: The budget deficit grew last year.

definition_en: To make worse; to treat without respect.
example_en: Overgrazing degrades the soil.

definition_en: Government elected by the people.
example_en: Free elections are the basis of democracy.

definition_en: Relating to population statistics.
example_en: The country is undergoing demographic change.

definition_en: To be a sign of something.
example_en: Red circles denote errors on the map.

definition_en: To greatly reduce the amount of something.
example_en: Overfishing depletes fish stocks.
example_uz: Haddan ortiq baliq ovlash zaxiralarni tugatadi.

definition_en: Money put in a bank; a natural layer of minerals.
example_en: She made a deposit at the bank.

definition_en: To take something necessary away from someone.
example_en: Noise deprives residents of sleep.

definition_en: To go down.
example_en: The plane began to descend.

definition_en: To officially choose for a purpose.
example_en: The area was designated a national park.

definition_en: To discover something hidden.
example_en: Sensors detect smoke early.
